notes: erp unit code may differ per ERP

source_file: source_file indicates the original query or ERP table used as source. "sync_alias" is the alias used in `sync_query.sql` CTEs. Destination columns follow the `public.*` schema in `database.sql`. Some columns require lookups (ERP id -> UUID)
source_column: conversions (0/1 -> boolean) or mapping enums to smallint values.
